description: Replace `RequiresHeadlessWrapper()` and the `xvfb-run -a` wrapping in scenario-to-desktop's smoketest with an emulator client call. Flow: create headless session, propagate the returned DISPLAY into the test command's env, destroy the session on completion. After this lands, scenario-to-desktop has zero remaining xvfb-run / procmetrics dependencies. See research/emulator-extraction-and-service-plan conclusion Findings 6 and 10.
name: smoketest-delegate-display-to-emulator
title: Migrate smoketest display management to vrooli-emulator
